reviewer.role: Acceptance reviewer; did not produce the run answer

case.must_observe.1.rationale: Compares payment-obligation objective, duplicate-key coverage/precision, pre-release timing, configuration independence, data/configuration dependencies and exception-review evidence, rather than matching control names.

case.must_observe.2.rationale: Treats automated blocking plus exception review as an alternative with conditional coverage: exact-key observations do not establish same-obligation variants or period-wide effectiveness. Requests variant, configuration-change and queue-resolution evidence before concluding equivalence or design gaps.

case.must_not_observe.1.rationale: Does not label manual-versus-automated difference a deficiency, mandate duplicate manual review, discard exception review or presume automation superior. Improvement options disclose false-positive/capacity trade-offs and remain draft.

limitations: Reviewer authored fixture/skill but not the answering run; not third-party assurance.
Synthetic configuration/log excerpts, not independently inspected systems or full-period testing.
